tour_01_new_gate.name: Jeonbuk National University New Gate
tour_01_new_gate.text: You are looking at the New Gate of Jeonbuk National University. Completed in 2019, it reinterprets traditional Korean hanok architecture and introduces the university's vision of a distinctly Korean campus. Notice the university name at the center. The calligraphy was written by Kim Byung-ki, then a professor in the Department of Chinese Language and Literature. By day, the hanok lines and structure stand out. At night, lighting creates a different atmosphere. Let us now enter the campus.
